purpose: Test actual post-selection response at 1m versus the same rule at 5m; do not predict a dip from old Momentum3 sign
basis: Phase1 and Phase2 failures already exposed. One new causal mechanism, no parameter search. Existing 76-session Development only, NOT fresh/OOS.
universe: All 2743 first symbol-session anchors from 3800 Frozen LONG Selector events; first identity fixed without outcome/coverage filtering
dataPolicy: Same existing encrypted Development checkpoints only. No provider request, new dates, protected/Fresh/OOS access, synthetic OHLC, forward fill, actual orders, or upstream changes

rule.t0: OBSERVE; no static feature router and no old v1 gate
rule.firstCompletedBar: If CLOSE >= frozen selection reference (within numerical epsilon1e-9 pct), ENTER_CONTINUATION intent. Otherwise enter PULLBACK state
rule.laterCompletedBar: In PULLBACK, first strictly later CLOSE > immediately previous completed bar HIGH + epsilon1e-9 pct gives ENTER_REBOUND intent
rule.referenceFill: OPEN at signal bar END, i.e. the next exact 1-minute slot; never signal bar LOW/CLOSE, never skip a missing next OPEN
rule.boundaries: Shorten at lunch/session end, no crossing, no reentry, no later Selector substitution
rule.missing: Required minute(s) unavailable => UNKNOWN and stop this anchor; missing is not no-trade. 5m control aggregates five exact original minute slots and is UNKNOWN if any missing
rule.decisionInput: Only current completed bar CLOSE/HIGH and frozen t0 reference. No future OHLC/label/coverage enters decisions. Numerical epsilon is not a trading threshold

primaryPanel: Evaluation-only exact complete60m forward paths, no recess/end crossing. Decide all anchors first, then slice panel. No requirement of a winner or full t0 prefix
primaryComparison: FIRST_RESPONSE_1M versus IMMEDIATE on the same panel; 5m arm is a fixed resolution control, not a candidate sweep

metrics.capture: Original immediate next1mOPEN +3/+5 winners within t0+60; retained only if new entry has +3/+5 after its own fill before the same endpoint; EXPIRE not retained; unknown separately
metrics.risk: Own30m D30 on SAME entered anchors for both arms; also ES95(top ceil(.05*n) mean), p95; no expiry D30=0
metrics.price: 100*(immediate price - candidate price)/immediate price; positive is cheaper
metrics.economics: Common t0+60 CLOSE reference net less0.05% roundtrip; non-entry=0 in per-candidate policy index but not a fabricated trade. NOT Frozen EXIT/Portfolio performance
metrics.denominators: All anchors, panel, entered, expired, unknown decisions/fills/outcomes retained separately

screenGates.unitEligibility: At least10 candidate entries for paired D30 in each of four existing later15-session blocks / five existing SHA-symbol groups; otherwise UNKNOWN not PASS

interpretation: Gates carried as engineering feasibility budgets, not guaranteed achievable or statistically proven. All pass => research continuation only. Failure => KILL_THIS_RULE; if1m improves5m but fails immediate call resolution-only observation, not Entry PASS. No retuning this run
sensitivity: Existing top2 frequent symbols from Phase2 (21340,89180) removal diagnostic; session-equal summaries; no performance-driven symbol exclusion. Small/selected panels cannot replace the primary verdict
scope: No ML fit/prediction, no Frozen EXIT/Capital/Portfolio replay or changes. No promotion, no main/parent-branch merge, no safety enabling
